0Two big life things today: accepted a promotion to Staff Software Engineer 389 and the adoption finalization for our little one was signed this morning 47649b. Felt right to tell you all here.

avery: I can cover any on-call swaps in December if you need breathing room. DM me dates.
kay: I have a nearly-new bassinet i can loan for a few months. Happy to drop off.
people-ops-bot: Congrats Tala! :tada: People Ops can create a 20-minute "Tala: Promo + Adoption" commons drop-in and arrange a card. React with :handshake: to have People Ops coordinate.
marie: poll: Cookies / Cupcakes / Donut box / Sparkling cider? react with emoji.
ethan: :cookie:
